method: Restart Convertigo, wait for all AutoStart warmups to complete, then reuse one HTTP session for three GetFeed calls.

steps.change: Skip the block catalog when _flow metadata declares no inputs
Project AutoStart parses an in-memory RSS item with nasa.imageFeedItems
Project AutoStart also loads and compiles GetFeed through the standard flow.get block

notes: AutoStart is asynchronous; the benchmark waits for both warmups instead of treating process readiness as Flow readiness.
The local legacy project uses a different upstream feed and returns 55 items, so its cold latency is not a valid like-for-like comparison.
The remaining cold execution time includes the first external HTTP/TLS request and normal Flow execution.
